tips.dashboardCardMenu: Right-click any card on the Dashboard to open its page, minimize it, give it a colour or hide it.
tips.shortcuts: Press ? anywhere outside a text box to see the keyboard shortcuts.
tips.micHandsFree: Click the microphone to talk hands-free: each pause sends what you said to the chat. Click it again to stop.
tips.floatingChat: Ctrl+Shift+C opens the floating chat on any page. Its chip names the page you are on, and the chat is told which page and record you have open.
tips.dropIntoFiles: Drag files or whole folders from your computer onto the Files page. They are uploaded where you drop them and indexed for chat and search.
tips.dashboardHiddenCards: Hid a Dashboard card by mistake? Right-click an empty part of the Dashboard to show it again.
tips.moveResizeCards: Cards on the Dashboard, Code Editor and Video Editor move by their title bar and resize from any edge or corner. Double-click a title bar to fold a card away.
tips.settingsHoverHelp: In Settings, a title with a dotted underline explains itself: rest the pointer on it.
tips.navigationModes: Settings → General → Navigation switches between the sidebar and a Workspaces bar that groups pages by task.
tips.dropIntoChat: Drop a document or an image into any chat to add it: documents are indexed, an image goes with your next message.
tips.micPushToTalk: Hold the microphone, or hold Ctrl+Shift+Space, to talk only while you hold it. Right-click the mic to change what a click does.
tips.dashboardLayouts: Right-click an empty part of the Dashboard to cycle its layout: Normal, Compact, Compact Layered and Mode-X. Cards stay free to move in every layout.
tips.footerJobs: While jobs run, the bar at the bottom shows them side by side. Rest the pointer on it to list every job; click to keep the list open.
tips.updateNotice: When Guaardvark is updated while it runs, a notice above the bottom bar says whether a page reload or a restart finishes the update.
tips.rightClickEverywhere: Right-click works across the app: files, notes, chat messages, jobs, rules, plugins and more each have their own menu.

push.label: Push to talk
push.help: Hold the mic (or Ctrl+Shift+Space) while you speak; release to send.

toggle.label: Tap to talk
toggle.help: Click, speak, and it sends when you pause. The mic closes after each message.

handsfree.label: Hands-free
handsfree.help: Click once and talk; every pause sends a message until you click again.

fast.label: ⚡ Fast
fast.description: Preview at the model's step floor (never below it)

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: Raw model output — fastest, lowest polish

cinema.label: Cinema
cinema.description: 2x FPS + 2x upscale — recommended for final output

fromLora.label: Auto (character LoRA base)
fromLora.description: Z-Image / SDXL / FLUX from the cast member’s training base

adaptive.label: Guaardvark — euler, adaptive shift
adaptive.description: Experimental: shift scales with resolution, floors at 3 below ~740px

westernCartoon.label: Western Cartoon
westernCartoon.description: Bold outlines, flat shading, snappy motion

wan225b.label: Wan 2.2 5B TI2V (Recommended)
wan225b.description: Fast 5s clips, fits 16GB — no offload. Text + image to video.

cogvideox5b.description: 6s videos, in-process diffusers — no ComfyUI needed (~16GB VRAM)

ltx23.description: Lightricks LTX-2.3 — 8 steps, up to ~10s on 16GB Ada. T2V + I2V.

minimaxH3Int8.description: MiniMax H3 — video with native stereo audio in one pass. 24fps, ~5s. T2V, first-frame and first+last-frame I2V. ComfyUI ≥ 0.30.

minimaxH3Int8Full.description: MiniMax H3 with the full modulation weights and the int8 encoder. 24GB-class cards; unmeasured.

minimaxH3Reference.description: MiniMax H3 reference-to-video: up to 9 pictures, 3 clips and 3 audio files lock identity, motion and voice, or edit and continue a clip. 24fps, native audio.

minimaxH3Bf16.description: MiniMax H3 at full precision with the bf16 encoder (~110GB of weights). Workstation cards; unmeasured.

hunyuanT2v.description: Tencent HunyuanVideo — cinematic motion, no content filter. 24fps, ~3s clips (16GB VRAM)

hunyuanI2v.description: HunyuanVideo image-to-video (v2) — follows the start frame closely. 24fps, ~3s (16GB VRAM)

ltx25.description: Lightricks LTX-2.5 — 8 steps, up to ~10s on 16GB Ada. T2V + I2V. Gated HF accept + ComfyUI ≥ 0.32.

zimage.high2k: Official recipe at 2K canvas — heavy; 16GB cards may refuse

flux3Klein.standard: Official ComfyUI template (15 steps, cfg 1, prompt upsampler on)

mossImage.high: Official settings from the model's guide (50 steps, cfg 3), slower

slashCommands.imagine: Generate an image from a text prompt
slashCommands.removebg: Remove the background from the attached photo (transparent PNG)
slashCommands.inpaint: Change or remove something in the attached photo
slashCommands.outpaint: Extend the attached photo and fill the new canvas
slashCommands.video: Queue a video clip from a text prompt
slashCommands.musicVideo: Start a music-video plan from a song (approve in Studio before clips render)
slashCommands.filmCrew: Start a Film Crew production from a screenplay (renders wait in Studio)
slashCommands.imagemodel: Switch chat image model (generation + editing) or show current
slashCommands.model: Switch LLM chat model or show current
slashCommands.websearch: Search the web, audit one page (site:<address>) or list a sitemap (sitemap:<url>)
slashCommands.gpu: Inspect live GPU lock, VRAM slots, and running plugins
slashCommands.logs: Tail a Guaardvark log (optional filename and grep)
slashCommands.sysmap: Report the System Mapper's findings, or ask it about the code: /sysmap where the seed box is, /sysmap module backend/app.py, /sysmap impact backend/services/agent_tools.py
slashCommands.swarm: Swarm orchestrator status (plugin must be running)
slashCommands.outreach: Outreach status, short verbs, or natural-language scout/draft (e.g. YouTube topics)
slashCommands.plan: Plan mode: look into it first, act only on a plan you approve
slashCommands.orchestrate: Split a request across several agents
slashCommands.training: Run the agent in training mode — full 1000-iteration loop, bypasses chat LLM decomposition
slashCommands.agent: Switch this chat into agent mode — every message becomes a screen-control task. Optional <task> fires immediately.
slashCommands.chat: Switch this chat back to chat mode (exits agent mode)
slashCommands.thinking: Toggle step-by-step reasoning for thinking models (gemma4:12b, qwen3) in this chat. Off = faster. Bare /thinking shows current state.
slashCommands.vision: Show Vision Pipeline plugin status (start/stop from the Plugins page)
slashCommands.clear: Start a fresh chat (the current one stays under All chats)
